title: Senior Salon Manager
description:
Senior Salon Manager

**Location:** Mumbai  
**Industry:** Premium / Luxury Salon & Beauty  
**Department:** Salon Operations  
**Experience:** 6–10 years in the Salon / Beauty Industry  
**Managerial Experience:** Minimum 3–5 years in a Salon Manager / Senior Salon Manager / Assistant Salon Manager / Salon Operations role

About the Role

JCB Salons is looking for an experienced and result-oriented **Senior Salon Manager** to lead the operations of our premium salon at **Mumbai**.

The ideal candidate should have strong experience in managing a premium or high-footfall salon, leading large teams, driving revenue and sales targets, managing client relationships, and ensuring high standards of service and salon operations.

The candidate will be responsible for the overall performance of the salon, including **business growth, team management, client experience, operational excellence, and revenue generation**.

Key Responsibilities

1. Salon Operations

* Manage the complete day-to-day operations of the salon.
* Ensure smooth functioning of all salon departments and services.
* Monitor appointments, walk-ins, staff availability, service flow, and salon capacity.
* Ensure adherence to company SOPs, operational processes, hygiene, grooming, and service standards.
* Ensure the salon is maintained to premium brand standards at all times.
* Coordinate with the Head Office and relevant departments for operational requirements.
* Identify operational gaps and implement corrective measures.

2. Sales & Revenue Management

* Take ownership of the salon's monthly and annual revenue targets.
* Drive service sales, retail sales, memberships, packages, and other revenue streams.
* Monitor daily, weekly, and monthly sales performance.
* Analyse revenue, average bill value, customer frequency, service mix, and team productivity.
* Drive upselling and cross-selling opportunities.
* Develop strategies to improve revenue, client retention, and repeat business.
* Ensure individual team members achieve their respective business targets.

3. Team Management

* Lead and manage the complete salon team, including stylists, beauticians, therapists, reception/front desk, and support staff.
* Plan staff rosters, shifts, leave schedules, and manpower deployment.
* Monitor individual and team performance.
* Conduct regular team briefings and performance reviews.
* Coach and motivate team members to improve productivity and service quality.
* Identify training and development requirements.
* Handle attendance, discipline, grooming, behavioural, and performance-related matters.
* Maintain a positive and professional working environment.

4. Client Experience & Relationship Management

* Ensure a premium and personalised customer experience.
* Build strong relationships with regular, premium, and VIP clients.
* Personally handle escalated customer complaints and service concerns.
* Ensure customer complaints are resolved professionally and within the required timelines.
* Monitor customer feedback and identify areas for improvement.
* Drive client retention, repeat visits, memberships, packages, and referrals.
* Ensure consistent service standards across all team members.

5. Performance & Business Analysis

* Review salon performance on a daily, weekly, and monthly basis.
* Track revenue, targets, productivity, staff utilisation, client footfall, average bill value, and other key performance indicators.
* Prepare and share regular performance reports with management.
* Identify trends and business opportunities to improve salon performance.
* Work with management on strategies for business growth and profitability.

6. Inventory & Stock Management

* Monitor professional products, retail products, consumables, and other salon inventory.
* Ensure adequate stock availability for daily operations.
* Monitor product usage and minimise wastage.
* Coordinate with the relevant teams for stock requirements and replenishment.
* Ensure proper storage and usage of salon products.

7. Administration & Compliance

* Ensure proper maintenance of salon records and operational documentation.
* Ensure compliance with company policies and procedures.
* Coordinate with HR regarding attendance, manpower requirements, employee concerns, and other people-related matters.
* Ensure all team members follow grooming, hygiene, and workplace standards.
* Maintain discipline and professional conduct within the salon.

8. Marketing & Business Development

* Support local marketing and promotional activities to increase salon footfall.
* Identify opportunities for client acquisition and retention.
* Work with the marketing and management teams on salon-specific campaigns and initiatives.
* Build relationships with local customers, corporates, luxury communities, and potential business partners where required.

Experience & Candidate Profile

* **6–10 years of overall experience in the Salon / Beauty Industry is mandatory.**
* Minimum **3–5 years of managerial experience** as a Salon Manager, Senior Salon Manager, Assistant Salon Manager, Salon Operations Manager, or equivalent role.
* Candidates must have prior experience managing a **premium, luxury, or high-footfall salon**.
* Experience managing a sizeable team of stylists, beauticians, therapists, receptionists, and support staff.
* Strong experience in **sales, revenue management, target achievement, client management, and salon operations**.
* Proven ability to drive business growth and improve team productivity.
* Experience handling premium and VIP clientele will be highly preferred.
* Experience with salon management software such as **Zenoti** or similar platforms will be an advantage.
* Strong leadership, communication, negotiation, and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent customer service and relationship-management skills.
* Strong commercial understanding with a result-oriented approach.
* Candidate should be well-groomed, confident, presentable, and professional.

Preferred Candidate Background

Preference will be given to candidates currently working or previously working with **reputed premium/luxury salon and beauty brands**.

Candidates from the following backgrounds may be considered:

* Premium / Luxury Salon Chains
* High-end Independent Salons
* Luxury Beauty & Wellness Brands
* Premium Spa & Wellness Businesses with strong salon operations

**Direct salon/beauty industry experience is mandatory.** Candidates with only general retail, hospitality, or non-salon management experience will not be preferred.

title: Platform Engineer
description:

**Platform Engineer (MLOps & DataOps)**

The MLOps & Data DevOps team enables Priceline’s data engineering, machine learning, and GenAI teams through secure, scalable, reliable, and governed platforms.

We build and operate the infrastructure, automation, deployment pipelines, observability, and self-service capabilities that allow engineering teams to deliver data and ML workloads safely to production.

If you enjoy working at the intersection of cloud infrastructure, DevOps, SRE, data platforms, and machine learning operations, this role offers an opportunity to build platform capabilities used across Priceline.

**Why this job’s a big deal**  
As Priceline expands its use of data, real-time analytics, machine learning, and GenAI, reliable platform engineering is critical to delivering business value safely and efficiently.

You will help operate the platform foundation behind data pipelines, ML pipelines, model endpoints, and LLM workloads. Your work will improve deployment speed, platform reliability, cost visibility, security, and the self-service experience for data and ML engineering teams.

This role is focused on platform engineering and operations. Data and ML teams own business logic, model development, testing, and domain-level data quality; the MLOps & DataOps team owns the infrastructure, deployment paths, automation, governance, and reliability practices that enable those workloads**.**

**In this role, you will:**

**1. Cloud Platform Infrastructure & Automation**

* Build, maintain, and improve Terraform modules and configurations for GCP data and ML platform services.
* Provision, operate, and automate cloud data and ML platform services such as Cloud Composer/Airflow, Dataproc, Dataflow, BigQuery, Cloud Storage, and Vertex AI.

Location: Mumbai \| Hybrid

Employment Type: Full\-time

Company: Digivero

About Digivero

Digivero is a boutique digital growth and brand strategy agency helping businesses build visibility, authority and demand in a rapidly changing digital and AI environment.

We specialise in working with IT, SaaS, AI, Cloud and Healthcare businesses, combining brand strategy, SEO, content, social media, video and performance marketing to create measurable business growth.

We are looking for a Junior Brand Strategist with B2B experience and an understanding of IT and/or Healthcare sectors to join our growing team.

About the Role

As a Junior Brand Strategist – B2B \| IT \& Healthcare, you will work closely with the strategy and marketing team to develop and execute brand communication for clients across the IT and Healthcare sectors.

This is not a purely social media execution role.

You will be expected to understand a client's business, target audience, industry, positioning and competitive environment — and translate that understanding into meaningful brand communication and content.

Key Responsibilities

1\. Brand Strategy \& Positioning

Support the development of brand positioning, messaging and communication strategies.

Understand client businesses, products, services and target audiences.

Help translate business objectives into marketing and brand communication.

Conduct market, industry and competitor research.

Assist in developing brand communication frameworks and content pillars.

Participate in internal and client brainstorming sessions.

Maintain consistency of brand voice and communication across platforms.

2\. IT \& Healthcare Marketing

Work on brands across sectors such as:

IT \& Technology

IT Services

SaaS

AI

Cloud

Cybersecurity

Technology Products

Enterprise Technology

Healthcare

Hospitals

Clinics

Diagnostics

MedTech

Pharma

Healthcare Technology

Wellness \& Healthcare Services

You should be comfortable learning about complex products, services and industries and converting them into simple, relevant and engaging communication.

3\. B2B Content \& Communication

Develop content ideas for B2B, IT and Healthcare brands.

Create LinkedIn posts, carousels, articles, campaigns and social media content.

Develop thought\-leadership content for founders, CEOs and senior executives.

Convert complex technical or healthcare information into clear business communication.

Develop content around customer pain points, industry trends and business challenges.

Support CXO and personal branding initiatives.

4\. Social Media

Develop and execute social media calendars.

Write and edit social media copy.

Coordinate with designers, video creators and other team members.

Schedule and publish content.

Monitor engagement and content performance.

Track basic analytics and identify opportunities for improvement.

5\. Research \& Insights

Research IT, Healthcare and related industries.

Conduct competitor and market research.

Track emerging trends in AI, technology, healthcare and digital marketing.

Identify content and communication opportunities.

Support preparation of client presentations, strategy documents and campaigns.

Who We Are Looking For

We are particularly interested in candidates who have:

1–3 years of experience in B2B marketing, digital marketing, content, branding or social media.

Experience working with IT, technology, SaaS, Healthcare or other B2B businesses.

An understanding of B2B audiences and decision\-making processes.

Strong written and verbal communication skills.

The ability to research and understand unfamiliar industries quickly.

The ability to simplify complex products and services into compelling communication.

Strong curiosity about AI, technology, healthcare and business trends.

Creative thinking combined with strategic and commercial thinking.

An eye for brand consistency and quality.

Good organisational skills and attention to detail.

Preferred Candidate Background

Candidates with experience in any of the following will be preferred:

B2B Marketing

IT / Technology Marketing

SaaS / AI / Cloud Marketing

Healthcare Marketing

MedTech / Pharma Marketing

Healthcare Technology

IT Services Marketing

Technology Content Writing

LinkedIn \& CXO Personal Branding

Digital Marketing Agency experience with B2B clients

Candidates with an IT/technology background who have moved into marketing are especially encouraged to apply.

Similarly, candidates with Healthcare industry experience combined with marketing/content experience are welcome.

A Good Fit If You...

Understand that B2B marketing is different from B2C marketing.

Enjoy researching a business and its industry before creating content.

Can understand a technology or healthcare offering and explain its value simply.

Can write for CXOs, business decision\-makers and professional audiences.

Think beyond simply "creating posts".

Want to understand why a brand communicates something, who it is communicating with and what business outcome it should create.

Are curious about how AI is changing marketing and business.

Want to grow into a strategic B2B brand marketer.

What You Will Learn at Digivero

You will gain hands\-on exposure to:

B2B Brand Strategy

IT \& Technology Marketing

Healthcare Marketing

AI Marketing

LinkedIn \& CXO Personal Branding

Content Strategy

SEO \& Digital Authority

Social Media Strategy

Performance Marketing

Market \& Competitor Research

Client Strategy

Integrated Digital Marketing

You will work across different businesses and industries and learn how brands move from:

Visibility → Authority → Demand → Business Growth

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Media, Business, IT, Healthcare Management or a related field.

2–3 years of relevant experience.

Prior B2B experience is strongly preferred.

IT, Technology or Healthcare sector experience will be an advantage.

Strong English communication and writing skills.

Candidates with an IT/technical background and marketing experience are encouraged to apply.

Why Join Digivero?

Digivero is a growing boutique agency where you will get the opportunity to work closely with founders, CXOs and marketing teams rather than being limited to one narrow function.

Join our dynamic team and make your mark on the payments technology landscape of tomorrow.


**Summary of This Role**
------------------------


Manages the operation, maintenance and administration of the organization's operating and management systems so that they function reliably, meet the organization's business needs, and use the organization's IT resources effectively. Oversees activities relating to technical guidance for planning, directing, and monitoring operating systems. Plans and recommends operating system modifications or additional equipment to increase the capacity of the system. Prepares operational cost estimates for current and proposed plans. Evaluates vendor proposals for purchases of hardware.

**What Part Will You Play?**
----------------------------

* Provides leadership for all aspects of a global multi\-data center environment. Coordinates the planning, acquisition, implementation, and support of systems deployed globally. Evaluates new technologies for optimal operational value and quality of service. Ensures compliance with regulatory and audit standards set forth by the Statement on Standards for Attestation Engagements (SSAE) No.16, Service Organization Controls Report (SOC1\), Federal Financial Institutions Examination Council (FFIEC), client contracts and other relevant standards. Ensures system security standards to protect customer data against unauthorized access.

Establishes and supervises the collection of analytics used for capacity analysis to accurately forecast future resource utilization requirements. Produces annual capacity plan and contribute to budget development, to support required infrastructure enhancements. Ensures scalability and accessibility of applications or services.
* Leads infrastructure change process for a global card authorizations environment. Ensures that change is consistently\-executed, with no interruptions to service. Provides technical leadership of group incident resolution process and root cause analysis. Facilitates large changes and other high\-risk activity. Manages monitoring of other teams' changes when requested.
* Leads the development and support of a disaster recovery and business continuity solution, to support a critical business service. Evaluates new technology to decrease recovery times and simplify recovery solutions. Executes recovery of the production environment to an out of region facility, within contractual time frames.
* Facilitates vendor relationships with major hardware and software providers, including problem management, enhancements, and support. Monitors vendor performance, products, and services. Participates in vendor events which focus on future products and services, industry trends, vendor strategic direction and similar topics. Meets regularly with internal staff to keep apprised of strategic direction and how it would be supported by current and future vendor relationships.
* Collaborates and provides recommendations to executive leadership on technology related issues. Engages global internal business partners to understand their support needs and coordinate the development of infrastructure to maintain relevant services as the payments environment evolves. Communicates effectively with current and prospective clients to align business needs with technical solutions. **Job Description**

**About Persistent**

  

We are an AI\-led, platform\-driven Digital Engineering and Enterprise Modernization partner, combining deep technical expertise and industry experience to help our clients anticipate what’s next. Our offerings and proven solutions create a unique competitive advantage for our clients by giving them the power to see beyond and rise above. We work with many industry\-leading organizations across the world, including 20 Fortune 50 companies and 4 of the 5 top banks in both the US and India, and numerous innovators across the healthcare ecosystem.

  

Our disruptor’s mindset, commitment to client success, and agility to thrive in the dynamic environment have enabled us to sustain our growth momentum. Persistent has been recognized across top industry platforms for innovation, leadership, and inclusion. We reported $1,654\.4M FY26 revenue with 17\.4% Y\-o\-Y growth. We have delivered 24 sequential quarters of growth with $436\.0M in Q4 FY26 revenue, up 3\.2% Q\-o\-Q and 16\.2% Y\-o\-Y growth. Our 27,500\+ global team members, located in 18 countries, have been instrumental in helping the market leaders transform their industries. We have been recognized as the Fastest Growing IT Services Brand Globally in the 2026 Brand Finance IT Services 25 Report. We named a Leader in the Everest Group Private Equity (PE) Services PEAK Matrix*®* Assessment 2026 and Software Product Engineering PEAK Matrix*®* Assessment 2026\.

 **About Position:**

  

We are seeking a highly skilled and proactive Peoplesoft Administration to drive automation\-led transformation across IT infrastructure services. This role is responsible for identifying overseeing ERP Technology, PeopleSoft System Administrators for day\-to\-day technical operation, security, availability, maintenance, and performance of COH’s PeopleSoft FSCM \& HCM platforms.

* **Role: Peoplesoft Administration**
* **Location: All Persistent Locations**
* **Experience: 6 to 10 Years**
* **Job Type: Full Time Employment**

 **What You'll Do:**

  

* Environment Administration (Managing the PeopleSoft environments for Dev, Test, Prod)
* Patch and Upgrade Management (addresses question 7\)
* Security Administration (system access control, user account administration, etc.)
* Production Support (Diagnosing and resolving outages, addressing middleware issues, etc.)
* Performance \& Capacity Management (monitoring resource utilization for CPU, memory, and disk, monitoring process scheduler performance, and working with developers on performance tuning)
* Project Migration between environments
* Infrastructure Coordination (with DBAs, Windows/Linux admins, SSL certificate management, disaster recovery exercises, etc.)

 **Expertise You'll Bring:**

  

* Environment Administration (Managing the PeopleSoft environments for Dev, Test, Prod)
* Patch and Upgrade Management (addresses question 7\)
* Security Administration (system access control, user account administration, etc.)
* Production Support (Diagnosing and resolving outages, addressing middleware issues, etc.)
* Performance \& Capacity Management (monitoring resource utilization for CPU, memory, and disk, monitoring process scheduler performance, and working with developers on performance tuning)
* Project Migration between environments
* Infrastructure Coordination (with DBAs, Windows/Linux admins, SSL certificate management, disaster recovery exercises, etc

 **Benefits:**

  

* Competitive salary and benefits package
* Culture focused on talent development with quarterly growth opportunities and company\-sponsored higher education and certifications
* Opportunity to work with cutting\-edge technologies
* Employee engagement initiatives such as project parties, flexible work hours, and Long Service awards
* Annual health check\-ups
* Insurance coverage: group term life, personal accident, and Mediclaim hospitalization for self, spouse, two children, and parents

 **Values\-Driven, People\-Centric \& Inclusive Work Environment:**

  

Persistent is dedicated to fostering diversity and inclusion in the workplace. We invite applications from all qualified individuals, including those with disabilities, and regardless of gender or gender preference. We welcome diverse candidates from all backgrounds.

  

* We support hybrid work and flexible hours to fit diverse lifestyles.
* Our office is accessibility\-friendly, with ergonomic setups and assistive technologies to support employees with physical disabilities.
* If you are a person with disabilities and have specific requirements, please inform us during the application process or at any time during your employment
